name: Ultrasound Therapy Unit
description: Advanced therapeutic ultrasound machine for deep tissue heating, promoting healing of muscles, tendons, and ligaments through acoustic energy.

name: TENS / IFT Machine
description: Dual-channel interferential and TENS therapy unit for pain management, muscle stimulation and edema reduction.

name: Traction Table
description: Motorized spinal decompression table for cervical and lumbar traction therapy, relieving disc compression and nerve root pain.

name: Laser Therapy Device
description: Low-level laser therapy device that accelerates tissue repair, reduces inflammation and relieves chronic pain at the cellular level.

name: Gait Training Treadmill
description: Specialized medical treadmill with body weight support system for neurological gait rehabilitation and balance training.

name: Shockwave Therapy Machine
description: Radial shockwave therapy for chronic tendinopathies, calcifications and myofascial pain syndromes.

name: Functional Electrical Stimulation
description: Wearable FES device for foot drop correction in neurological patients, stimulating the peroneal nerve during walking.

name: Hydrotherapy Pool
description: Heated therapeutic pool for aquatic physiotherapy, reducing joint load while enabling effective rehabilitation exercises.
